title: The DREB7 transcription factor enhances salt tolerance in soybean plants under salt stress.
authors: Nguyen, Giang Thu; Nguyen, Yen Thi Hai; Nguyen, Hung Duc; Chu, Mau Hoang; Nguyen, Quan Huu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究大豆DREB7转录因子在盐胁迫下通过结合GmP5CS启动子增强脯氨酸积累，含分子对接验证TF-DNA互作，但以湿实验为主、AI/物理模拟方法较浅，属广义TF-DNA互作且方法可借鉴的中档文献。
abstract: DREB7 in Glycine max (L) is a novel trans-acting transcription factor (TF) that binds to the cis-acting sequences of promoters to activate the expression of downstream genes in response to abiotic factors. This study presents the experimental results and analyzes the relationship between the overexpression of the GmDREB7 and GmP5CS, as well as the proline content, in transgenic soybean lines. The results of qRT-PCR analysis of four TG1 transgenic soybean lines (TG1-2, TG1-5, TG1-7, and TG1-10) showed that the GmDREB7 gene had significantly higher transcriptional expression under untreated and salt stress conditions. Under salt stress conditions, the two transgenic lines, TG1-5 and TG1-10, had the most significant increase in GmDREB7 and GmP5CS gene expression levels, as well as the highest proline accumulation (P < 0.05). The in silico molecular docking analysis confirmed a specific interaction between the DREB7 protein and GmP5CS promoter. These findings demonstrate that overexpression of the gene encoding the TF DREB7 enhanced the transcription of the GmP5CS gene and increased proline accumulation in soybean plants under salt stress conditions. The GmDREB7 gene can be a promising candidate for enhancing salt tolerance in soybeans.
abstract_zh: 大豆（Glycine max (L)）中的DREB7是一种新型反式作用转录因子（trans-acting transcription factor, TF），其结合启动子的顺式作用序列，以响应非生物因素激活下游基因的表达。本研究展示了实验结果，并分析了转基因大豆品系中GmDREB7和GmP5CS过表达与脯氨酸含量之间的关系。对四个TG1转基因大豆品系（TG1-2、TG1-5、TG1-7和TG1-10）的qRT-PCR分析结果显示，在未处理和盐胁迫条件下，GmDREB7基因的转录表达显著升高。在盐胁迫条件下，两个转基因品系TG1-5和TG1-10中GmDREB7和GmP5CS基因表达水平的增加最为显著，且脯氨酸积累量最高（P < 0.05）。计算机模拟分子对接分析确认了DREB7蛋白与GmP5CS启动子之间的特异性相互作用。这些发现表明，过表达编码转录因子DREB7的基因增强了GmP5CS基因的转录，并在盐胁迫条件下增加了大豆植株中的脯氨酸积累。GmDREB7基因可作为增强大豆耐盐性的有前景的候选基因。
